text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 283 tablets of carvedilol 25 mg, providing 19.5 days of supply at the current usage rate of 14.5 tablets per day.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include carvedilol as of 2026-10-21. FDA inspection records for the relevant plant show an OAI classification in 2009 and a series of VAI inspections through 2026, with the most recent VAI known date of 2026-10-14.

Our position: Current inventory is below the target safety stock threshold. No shortage is declared by FDA, but proactive sourcing is required to avoid a stockout.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Advagen Pharma Limited (ranked first alternate) pending P&T committee approval of the manufacturer change.
2. Buyer to place orders with Advagen Pharma Ltd. (ranked second alternate) pending P&T committee approval of the manufacturer change.
3. Buyer to place orders with Aurobindo Pharma Limited (ranked third alternate) pending P&T committee approval of the manufacturer change.
4. Buyer to place orders with BluePoint Laboratories (ranked fourth alternate) pending P&T committee approval of the manufacturer change.
5. Buyer to place orders with Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited (ranked fifth alternate) pending P&T committee approval of the manufacturer change.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until inventory reaches critical levels.
